race.title: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Handicap (0-60)
race.verdict: MEDIEVAL NIGHT has posted several solid efforts in defeat this season and, with the step back up in trip likely to suit, is taken to finally shed his maiden tag from a career-low rating. Past C&D winner Syosset is feared most after a good spell over hurdles and an excuse latest, while Prada's World can also get involved after a good recent run. MEDIEVAL NIGHT (IRE) SYOSSET (IRE) PRADA'S WORLD (IRE)
